overloads.semanticRole: SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS temporarily changes all the manual relations into automatic relations for the entire database in the current process.

constraints: Change is temporary (applies only for the current process) and persists until a subsequent call to SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS, not permanently to the Design-environment relation settings.
one controls all manual Many-to-One relations for the entire database; many controls all manual One-to-Many relations, following the same True=automatic / False=revert-to-manual semantics as one.
Relations already set as automatic in the Design environment are not affected by this command.

Passing True 'locks' automatic mode for all manual relations during the session: subsequent calls to SET FIELD RELATION during the same session are ignored, regardless of whether they occur before or after this call.
